commons.title: Bosniak population in Serbia and Montenegro.jpg
commons.description:
Bosniaks in Serbia and Montenegro according to population censuses held in 2002 and 2003, respectively. 


Statistical Office of Serbia (2003)    (in serbian)   Србија у бројкама 2003. (PDF), Belgrade:  Statistical Office of Serbia. Archived from the original on 17 November 2015. Retrieved on 25 July 2007. 
Popis stanovnistva, domacinstava i stanova u 2003., STANOVNISTVO; nacionalna ili etnicka pripadnost, podaci po naseljima i opstinama, knjiga 1, Podgorica, septembar 2004 MONSTAT.
commons.editorial_reason: Population-distribution map; it does not visibly show Bosniak culture.
